news_articles.title: Assassin's Creed: Black Flag Resynced devs request: "please play us when GTA 6 comes out"
news_articles.snippet: Last week, Ubisoft announced the New Games Plus option, which will be "one of the first things" to be added in the coming months.

news_articles.title: Ghost Recon: Wildlands looks set for PS5 upgrade at 4K, 60FPS.
news_articles.snippet: Ubisoft appears to be preparing an updated and enhanced version of PS4 open worlder Ghost Recon: Wildlands, as per a new graphic uploaded to its Xbox Store page.

news_articles.title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced sells over 3 million copies, New Game+ is coming.
news_articles.snippet: The remake earned strong Steam reception and sales despite criticism over day-one DLC and recent layoffs at Ubisoft Barcelona.

news_articles.title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced devs confirm New Game+.
news_articles.snippet: If you've already ploughed through the Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced achievements and would like a reason to return, TrueAchievements has some good news: Ubisoft is currently working on a New Game+ mode.

news_articles.title: Players like sheep. Ubisoft mowed millions on such a stupid DLC that it's mind-boggling.
news_articles.snippet: Ubisoft prepared a wide package of optional DLC to buy along with the game.

news_articles.title: Platforming classic Rayman Origins looks fab in 4K on PS5.
news_articles.snippet: Back when Ubisoft announced it was reimagining Rayman Legends for PS5, it also confirmed that 2011's Rayman Origins would be getting an Enhanced Edition for modern hardware.

news_articles.title: World of Tanks and Ubisoft partner to launch Battle Pass Special: Far Cry.
news_articles.snippet: World of Tanks and Ubisoft partner to launch Battle Pass Special: Far Cry.

news_articles.title: World of Tanks introduces Battle Pass Special: Far Cry.
news_articles.snippet: July 13, 2026 - The World of Tanks team today announces a partnership with Ubisoft to launch Battle Pass Special: Far Cry, a limited-time event inspired by the wild and lawless spirit of the FARCRY universe.

news_articles.title: World of Tanks introduces Battle Pass Special: Far Cry.
news_articles.snippet: The World of Tanks team today announces a partnership with Ubisoft to launch Battle Pass Special: Far Cry, a limited-time event inspired by the wild and lawless spirit of the FARCRY universe.

news_articles.title: 'Not a fun time': Quebec video game industry in limbo as studios cut back.
news_articles.snippet: Ubisoft laid off nearly 140 employees after shuttering studios in Halifax and Winnipeg.

news_articles.title: Ubisoft reveals return of Assassin's Creed "Edward Kenway" skin in Rayman Legends.
news_articles.snippet: Ubisoft reveals return of Assassin's Creed "Edward Kenway" skin in Rayman Legends.

news_articles.title: Far Cry 7 leak reveals Alaska setting and 72-hour timer feature.
news_articles.snippet: Previous leaks hinted that Ubisoft was working on an extraction-based experience, and the latest info confirms that the mode is still very much part of the project.

news_articles.title: Ubisoft responds to Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced microtransaction criticism, says optional DLC is "never a requirement"
news_articles.snippet: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced has officially launched, but alongside positive reactions to its faithful recreation of the beloved pirate adventure, Ubisoft is facing criticism over the game's optional paid content.

news_articles.title: World of Tanks brings you closer to Far Cry.
news_articles.snippet: The World of Tanks team today announced a partnership with Ubisoft to launch the Battle Pass Special: Far Cry - a limited-time event inspired by the Far Cry universe.

news_articles.title: Ubisoft will be represented at the Esports World Cup 2026: Rainbow Six Siege & Trackmania in Paris.
news_articles.snippet: Ubisoft has announced its participation in the Esports World Cup 2026 in Paris, where both Rainbow Six Siege and Trackmania will be among the world's leading esports titles.

news_articles.title: Assassin's Creed: Codename Hexe leaks point to Ubisoft's darkest game yet with a stronger focus on stealth.
news_articles.snippet: A wave of new rumors and leaks surrounding Assassin's Creed: Codename Hexe has painted a much clearer picture of what Ubisoft may be developing.

news_articles.title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced isn't out yet, but it's already outselling Shadows.
news_articles.snippet: According to Elliott, head of market research at Alinea, the game has already accumulated over 300,000 pre-orders on Steam, generating approximately $14 million in gross revenue for Ubisoft before launch.

news_articles.title: Ubisoft leaker shares new details on Far Cry 7.
news_articles.snippet: For years now, we have been hearing various leaks and rumours surrounding Far Cry, with the primary consensus being that Ubisoft is working on two games right now: Far Cry 7 (known as project Blackbird) and a multiplayer extraction shooter spin-off (project Maverick).

news_articles.title: Just Dance: Decades of Hits announced.
news_articles.snippet: Ubisoft today announced the next entry in the Just Dance series, Just Dance: Decades of Hits.

news_articles.title: Ubisoft's new Ghost Recon game threatened by Red Storm Entertainment layoffs.
news_articles.snippet: Ubisoft is developing a new Ghost Recon title under the internal codename Project OVR, but the game's future may already be in jeopardy following a wave of layoffs at the studio behind it.
